content_zh:
看着又欲转身逃跑的骑士，刘枫不耐烦的撇了撇嘴。
随手甩出手中长剑，在骑士骇然的目光中，穿过其项间，去势仍不止，将那具失去生机的尸体，挂在了墙上。
刘枫伸出白皙的手掌，在衣服上面狠狠的搽拭了一下。
信步走出大门，由于天色已暗，街上并没有什么行人。
走了几步，刘枫一顿，回过头来，看着那在暗夜中不断闪耀的魔法文字。
不屑的笑了笑，袖袍一挥，庞大的内劲破空而去，将之砸得粉碎。
满天的光点飘散。
“狂想佣兵团”随之烟散云消。
***************
“小枫，你回来了？”坐在院子里的石椅上的莫非，看着踏入大门的身影，喜道。
“呵呵，恩。”在朋友面前，刘枫放下了那层冷漠的杀戮外衣，点了点头，微笑着问道：“团长，他们没事吧？”
“恩，贝法和巴达斯到没什么大事，只是团长伤得有些重，可能有一个月都出不了任务了，TM的，这些王八蛋下手真狠。”莫非点了点头，随既有些愤怒的骂道。
在愤怒的情绪之下，全忘了精灵的优雅。
“算了，休息一个月就一个月吧，只要人在就好，至于那些王八蛋嘛，已经消失了。”刘枫安慰道，说到最后的消失，语气极其平淡。
“你。。把他们全都。。”莫非伸手在虚空之中划了一下。
“恩，要怪就怪他们得罪了得罪不起的人吧。”刘枫不在意的点了点头。
“哎，你。。算了。算了。宰了就宰了吧，关我什么事？”虽然精灵爱好和平的性子有些接受不了这一残酷的现实，但是最后还是同伴的友谊占得了上风，只得苦笑着摇了摇头。
“嘿嘿，你快出去，买点东西回来吃吧，我去看看团长他们。”刘枫嘿嘿一笑，心中对莫非的表现很是满意。
看着刘枫摇摆着进入房间的背影，莫非再次苦笑一声。
轻轻推开木门，刘枫脚步放轻，对着已经发现自己的矮人做了一个小声的动作。

巴达斯聪明的住了嘴，嘿嘿一笑，压低声音问道：“小枫，你给我们去报仇没？”
看着满身伤痕的巴达斯不关心自己的伤势，却来问这个，刘枫不由一声苦笑：“恩，包你满意就是。”
“嘿嘿。”巴达斯闻言，裂嘴一笑，拍了拍刘枫的肩膀：“不错，你小子真够意思。”
刘枫翻了翻白眼，低声喝道：“别乱动，等好了，你还要跟着去跑任务呢，别想因此偷懒。”
“呵呵。”在床塌上斜靠着的贝法，听到这句话，不由一乐：“我就是在怀疑，当时，叫他回来报信他不肯的时候，就是怀的这个念头。”
巴达斯双眼怒睁，一蹦半丈高，就要吼出声来，却被刘枫一掌给打了回去。
“安静些，团长还没醒呢。”
“贝法，你怎么样了？”刘枫看着贝法那身上的血痕，问道。
“嘿嘿，放心吧，枫哥，我没事。只是点皮外伤，很快就好了。”贝法嘿嘿笑道。
“好了，你们先休息吧，等明天团长醒了再说吧。”
****************
翌日清晨，肯斯终于慢慢的醒了过来，这让刘枫也悄悄的松了一口气。
“小枫，你跟我说实话，你把狂想佣兵团怎么样了？”肯斯撑起身子，问道。
“还能怎样，你都知道的。”刘枫耸了耸肩，拿起桌上的水果，狠狠的咬了一口。
“哎，你小子。。就不能。。”肯斯一声苦笑：“在“日不落”杀人，很严重的，说不定，执法队，现在就已经查到我们了。”
“哦？”刘枫眼神一凝，随既恢复了正常。
“执法队是“日不落”的维护部队，就是专门对佣兵而设立的暴力组织，里面至少都是五阶强者。”
“里面很多人？”
“不过，据说只有一百多人而已，不过。。听说。这支执法队的首领是日不落城主：奥特大公的亲兄弟，大陆顶级星辰强者，奥郝。”
“九阶星辰强者？”刘枫脸色一正，没想到这“日不落”还真是藏龙卧虎的地方啊。

不过，一名星辰强者对刘枫来说，并没有让他有什么惧怕的感觉，反而心中有些跃跃欲试，星辰阶的强者。。当初在死亡森林中，那三位老者，虽然只是昙花一现，但还是给了刘枫极大的震撼。

content_en:
Looking at the knight who was about to turn around and run away again, Liu Feng curled his lips impatiently.
He casually threw out the long sword in his hand, and under the horrified gaze of the knight, passed through his neck. The castration continued, and he hung the lifeless corpse on the wall.
Liu Feng stretched out his white palm and wiped it hard on his clothes.
Walking out of the door, there were not many pedestrians on the street because it was already dark.
After walking a few steps, Liu Feng paused, turned around, and looked at the magic words that kept shining in the dark night.
He smiled disdainfully, waved his sleeves, and the huge inner energy flew through the air, smashing it into pieces.
Spots of light scattered across the sky.
The "Rhapsody Mercenary Group" disappeared.
***************
"Xiao Feng, are you back?" Mo Fei, who was sitting on a stone chair in the yard, looked at the figure stepping into the door and said happily.
"Haha, yes." In front of his friends, Liu Feng put down his cold and murderous coat, nodded, and asked with a smile: "Captain, are they okay?"
"Well, nothing happened to Befa and Badas. It's just that the captain was injured a little bit seriously. He may not be able to go on missions for a month. Damn, these bastards are really cruel." Mo Fei nodded, and then cursed with some anger.
In his anger, he completely forgot about the elf's elegance.
"Forget it, just take a month's rest. As long as the person is here, it's fine. As for those bastards, they have disappeared." Liu Feng comforted him, speaking of the last disappearance, his tone was extremely calm.
"You... take them all..." Mo Fei stretched out his hand and scratched in the void.
"Well, if you want to blame them, just blame them for offending someone who can't afford to offend." Liu Feng nodded nonchalantly.
"Hey, you...forget it. Forget it. Just kill him. What does it have to do with me?" Although the elf's peace-loving temperament could not accept this cruel reality, in the end, the friendship of his companions prevailed, and he could only shake his head with a wry smile.
"Hey, go out quickly and buy something to eat. I'll go see the group leader and the others." Liu Feng chuckled, feeling very satisfied with Mo Fei's performance.
Looking at Liu Feng's back as he swayed into the room, Mo Fei smiled bitterly again.
Gently pushing the wooden door open, Liu Feng stepped lightly and made a small gesture towards the dwarf who had discovered him.
Badas wisely stopped talking, chuckled, and asked in a low voice: "Xiao Feng, are you going to take revenge on us?"
Seeing that Badas, who was covered in scars, didn't care about his injuries, but came to ask this, Liu Feng couldn't help but smile bitterly: "Well, I guarantee your satisfaction."
"Hehe." When Badas heard this, he smiled and patted Liu Feng on the shoulder: "Yes, you are really interesting."
Liu Feng rolled his eyes and shouted in a low voice: "Don't move around. Wait, you have to follow me to run the mission. Don't be lazy because of this."
"Haha." Befa, who was leaning on the bed, couldn't help but feel happy when he heard this sentence: "I just suspected that this was the idea I had when I asked him to come back and report that he refused."
Badas' eyes widened angrily. He jumped half a foot high and was about to roar, but Liu Feng slapped him back.
"Be quiet, the leader hasn't woken up yet."
"Beifa, how are you?" Liu Feng looked at the blood marks on Beifa's body and asked.
"Hehe, don't worry, Brother Feng, I'm fine. It's just a little skin injury, it'll be fine soon." Befa chuckled.
"Okay, you guys should rest first and wait until the leader wakes up tomorrow."
****************
The next morning, Kensi finally woke up slowly, which made Liu Feng quietly breathe a sigh of relief.
"Xiao Feng, tell me the truth, what did you do to the Mad Fantasy Mercenary Group?" Kensi stood up and asked.
"What else can you do, you all know." Liu Feng shrugged, picked up the fruit on the table, and took a hard bite.
"Hey, you kid. . Just can't. . Kensi gave a wry smile: "Killing people on "The Sun Never Sets" is very serious. Maybe the law enforcement team will have found us by now." "
"oh? "Liu Feng's eyes condensed, and then returned to normal.
"The law enforcement team is a maintenance force where the sun never sets. It is a violent organization specially set up to deal with mercenaries. They are all at least level five strong men. "
"A lot of people inside? "
“However, it is said that there are only more than a hundred people, but. . Heard. The leader of this law enforcement team is the Lord of the City on which the Sun Never Sets: Ao Hao, the brother of Archduke Ultra and the top star powerhouse in the mainland. "
“A ninth-level star powerhouse? "Liu Feng's face straightened. He didn't expect that this "sun never sets" is really a place where dragons and tigers are hidden.
However, for Liu Feng, a star powerhouse did not make him feel any fear. Instead, he felt a little eager to try a star-level powerhouse. . In the forest of death, those three old men, although they were just a flash in the pan, still gave Liu Feng a great shock.
